_meta.title: Owner-supplied figures and owner-authorised rough estimates for the Oxyniti yield calculator
_meta.authority: Vivian (owner), chat message 2026-09-21: '1-2 lpm for 1.5 hp NBG; 230V, 3 A power for oxygen concentrator; the rest make rough estimate'. Estimates below are labelled ASSUMED with their basis and are editable on the page.
_meta.rule: tools/build_data.py overlays these onto products.data.js and economics.data.js. VERIFIED here means stated by the owner on the date given; ASSUMED means a rough estimate the owner asked for.

o2_input_lpm.source: owner statement 2026-09-21 ('1-2 lpm for 1.5 hp NBG'); product page says 'up to 2 LPM'
o2_input_lpm.note: midpoint 1.5 L/min is used by the model

concentrator_kw.source: owner statement 2026-09-21: 230 V, 3 A; 230 x 3 = 690 VA; power factor taken as 1.0 (ASSUMED, conservative for running cost)

price_inr.unit: INR per generator unit, ex-works, GST inclusive
price_inr.source: rough estimate authorised by the owner: CRI 1 HP stainless multistage pump lists at Rs 12,450 (IndiaMART, Surat, read 2026-09-21), a 1.5 HP MHC-class pump taken as about Rs 20,000; stainless venturi/nozzle, frame, hoses, control panel about Rs 25,000; assembled-product factor about 1.9x on components. Range Rs 60,000-1,10,000. Replace with the real list price.

concentrator_price_inr.source: rough estimate: 5 L/min medical-grade PSA concentrators retail Rs 35,000-60,000 in India (oxygentimes.com price list, Sep 2026, read 2026-09-21); one concentrator per generator unit ASSUMED

maintenance_pct_per_year.source: rough estimate: pump seals, filters and PSA sieve replacement; no OEM figure

o2_input_lpm.source: product page says 'up to 6 LPM'; range scaled from the owner's 1-2 L/min for the 1.5 HP unit
o2_input_lpm.note: midpoint 4.5 L/min is used by the model

concentrator_kw.source: 10 L/min-class PSA concentrators draw roughly 0.6-1.0 kW; upper value taken, scaled from the owner's 0.69 kW for the smaller unit

price_inr.unit: INR per generator unit, ex-works, GST inclusive
price_inr.source: rough estimate authorised by the owner: 4 HP CRI MHS-16 class pump about Rs 55,000; fittings, frame, panel about Rs 40,000; assembled-product factor about 1.7x. Range Rs 1,20,000-2,20,000. Replace with the real list price.

concentrator_price_inr.source: 10 L/min oxygen concentrators list at Rs 60,000-1,20,000 (oxygentimes.com, Sep 2026, read 2026-09-21); midpoint taken

concentrators_per_unit.source: one PSA concentrator per generator unit; a larger shared concentrator would lower capex per unit
